description: Get block information from the Klever blockchain by nonce (block number). If no nonce is provided, returns the latest block. Returns hash, timestamp, proposer, number of transactions, and other block metadata.

network.description: Network to query. Options: "mainnet", "testnet", "devnet", "local". Defaults to server default (mainnet).

nonce.description: Block number (nonce). Omit to get the latest block.

name: get_block
